driftObservedDuringStageA.swarmChildHomePlaywright: Swarm runs every child command under its own scratch HOME (/var/folders/.../T/swarm-child-home), where no Playwright browsers existed at the first launch. chai's `npm test` includes `test-chrome` (web-test-runner with Playwright), so Swarm's blocking `tests` gate failed in the upgrade launch (`browserType.launch: Executable doesn't exist`). The model's automatic repair attempt then ran `npx playwright install chromium`, which downloaded 479 MB of browsers into that scratch HOME at 18:35 to 18:36 local; the later chai feature launch's `tests` gate passed with Chromium (510 tests). This is an environment change made by the arm inside its own scratch HOME, not by the harness; it is disclosed here and in the report and is why the two chai Swarm launches did not run under the same gate environment.
driftObservedDuringStageA.swarmGateCommandNotConfigured: The task text tells both arms the project test command is `npm run test-node`; Swarm's gate plan reads the project's `npm test` script (test-node and test-chrome). swarm.toml supports a [gates] override for the tests command, and the harness writes only the [providers] table, so the product ran in its default mode as the comparison protocol states. OpenCode was never asked to run `npm test`.
